name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled static sites, including virtual hosts, document roots, security headers, rate limiting, TLS, fail2ban, UFW, SSH hardening, sysctl settings, and sample HTML content.

name: cache
description: Provisions Memcached and Redis cache services, including Redis authentication, configuration, logging directories, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs system and Python prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI application, creates a virtual environment, configures PostgreSQL and application environment settings, and runs the application through systemd and Uvicorn.
